capabilities: record task status with an optional summary and completion date
sink completed tasks to the end of their sibling list without crossing headings or parent tasks
write completed or partially completed entries to Daily Notes
archive completed tasks grouped by day, week, or month
undo the latest status, checkbox, or archive operation, including after restart
extras: Warns that auto-organize is enabled for the entire vault on new installations and advises reviewing scope and excluded folders before using it in an existing vault. Fully local and offline; English and Simplified Chinese interfaces.
problem: On a centralized task page, completed tasks clutter the list and Obsidian does not record when a task was actually completed or move it out of the way.

relations.evidence: run Record task status from the command palette, Commander, or a mobile toolbar

summary: Task workflow that records task completion, sinks completed tasks to their list end, writes Daily Note entries, archives by date, and undoes operations.
